eps.t: Phineas and Ferb: Arch-Enemy Day Off!
eps.o: Dr. Doof and Perry the Platypus hang out to celebrate a fun and special holiday: the one day a year they don't have to be arch-enemies.

eps.t: Phineas and Ferb: Cool it Candace
eps.o: When Candace goes on a romantic date with Jeremy at the malt shop, she can't stop freaking out about her brothers trying out their new experiments around town.
In this Chibi music video, Bridget from “Descendants: The rise of Red”sings the simply delicious song, "Life is Sweeter."
When Dr. Doof becomes afraid his daughter Vanessa is growing up too fast, he invents a Cutie-inator to make her world more childlike.

eps.t: The Cheetah Girls: As Told by Chibi
eps.o: In a Chibi retelling of the beloved Disney Channel Original Movie “The Cheetah Girls”, we follow the exciting story of how four talented girls became musical superstars.
When Chip is out sick for the day, Kiff Chatterley steps in to help Dale and the rest of the "Rescue Rangers." But is she a good fit for the team?
The mischievous Red decides to spray-paint some graffiti around her mom's castle while trying to escape the watchful eye of the Queen of Hearts' guards.

eps.t: Camp Rock 2: As Told by Chibi
eps.o: Lumi Pollack recaps the story of “Camp Rock 2: The Final Jam” to the tune of the "Camp Rock" classic, "Introducing Me."
When the rune's evil magic turns cheese into a terrifying monster, things are not gouda. Bobby and Romy need to stop the brie baddie before it stinks up the town.
A mime statue is brought to life by the rune's evil magic. Can Bobby and Romy capture the mime or will they be given the silent treatment forever?
When Bobby and Romy are in the lighthouse, they see a terrifying monster getting closer and closer to them with each turn of the bulb. Can Kim save them before it's too late?
In this epic Chibi-crossover short, all of your favorite Disney Channel Chibis have gathered together at a Halloween carnival to celebrate spooky season.
Red gets frustrated when her perky sister Pink seems to pop up and surprise her everywhere she goes! Will the two sisters learn to get along?
Chessy tricks the Fairy Godmother into putting on an evil bracelet which transforms her into a SCARY Godmother! Can Red and Chloe help turn her back to normal?
When Red, Pink, Luis, and Hazel compete in a game of flamingo croquet, a mischievous Hazel has a couple tricks up her sleeve.
